summary: Frontend-only E2E testing (Playwright, 390px and 1920px) of Phase 0: public layout, auth screens, owner first sign-in (2FA enrolment + recovery codes + forced password change), 2FA sign-in, admin shell (rail, bottom bar, More sheet, customize bar), Dashboard, Users, Staff, Settings, Keys, Logs, Security, Health, Site Studio (preset, draft, preview, publish, versions), Pages, Inbox, Announcements, Plans and all 6 Account tabs. Backend not touched. Found 3 blocking frontend bugs: Users page crashed, every as='select' Field was broken, Staff invite link was never shown. I fixed all 3 with minimal edits and checked them again. Also found an auth/me rate-limit problem, reported below. After the fixes nearly every requested flow works.

minor.issue: Counts toward the per-IP 'auth' bucket (security.rate_limit_auth_per_minute = 10/min). Each full page load plus each refresh() call (Notifications switches, Profile save, sign-in) uses one. Sign-in failed with 'Too many requests' in testing. Backend must not change, so this needs a frontend mitigation (see action_items).
2fa:{ip} limit is 10 per 15 min. After about 9 sign-ins in 15 min the code screen shows 'Too many requests. Try again soon.' FYI only. It slows down repeated testing.
After toggle and then Reset to default, the History drawer shows only the PUT entry. The reset is not listed (it is in the audit log). FYI.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER. The Users page crashed on every render ('The above error occurred in the <UserDrawer> component', whole admin went blank). JSX children are evaluated even when Drawer is closed, and with d=null `d.plan?.plan_name` / `actions.map` threw. The same happened right after opening a row, before loading started. Fix: render <Loading/> when `q.loading || !d`.

FIXED BY TESTER. With `as="select"` and children, Field rendered `children || <Tag/>`, so only bare <option>s appeared and there was no <select>. Broken: Account time zone, Staff invite role (invites always went out as 'support'), Users role-change dialog, Announcements level/audience, Inbox status, Plans price interval. Fix: always render <Tag {...p}>{children}</Tag>.

FIXED BY TESTER. The invite link (shown because e-mail is off) never appeared. onDone() reloads the list, then `if (q.loading) return <Loading/>` unmounted Invite and lost the link state. Fix: `if (q.loading && !q.data)`.

Any error from GET /auth/me, including 429, sets me={user:null}. Code reading shows a rate-limited staff user would look signed out: /admin shows 404, the header shows 'Sign in', Gates do not run. Not reproduced live because the 2FA limit was hit before the reproduction script ran. auth/me 429s were seen in the console and the sign-in UI.

action_items: Review the 3 fixes I applied (Users.jsx drawer null guard, Ui.jsx Field select children, Staff.jsx loading guard) and look for the same 'children evaluated while closed' pattern elsewhere
AuthProvider.refresh: do not treat 429/5xx/network errors as signed out. Keep the previous `me` and retry after Retry-After. Only a 2xx {user:null} should sign out
Cut /auth/me calls: after profile/prefs PATCH, merge the response into `me` instead of calling refresh() (the auth/me bucket is 10/min per IP)
Fix the recovery-code grid overlap at 390px
Show a friendly device name instead of the raw user-agent on Account > Devices
Use sentence case for admin labels instead of text-transform capitalize ('E-mails today', 'Unsaved draft'). Fix '1 people'. Fix the 'Prediciotn' fallback

Run reset_admin.py and clean up: TEST_staff_invite@example.com (role support), TEST_staff_invite2@example.com (analyst), TEST_signup_ui@example.com (unverified sign-up), owner note 'TEST note from UI testing', owner profile name 'TEST Owner' and tz Europe/London, an 'about' page row (title 'About', empty body; it did not exist before), Site config versions 1 and 2 (v2 = midnight preset + brand 'Forecast', which may differ from the original default config, v0)
critical_code_review_comments: Ui.jsx Field: `children || <Tag/>` dropped the element for every select. Fixed
Users.jsx: the drawer body dereferenced `d` without a null check. React evaluates JSX children even when Drawer returns null. Fixed
Staff/Dashboard/SecurityHealth/Markdown/Account Plan: `if (q.loading) return <Loading/>` unmounts the page on every reload and loses local state and scroll. Prefer `q.loading && !q.data`
auth.js: the catch-all in refresh() turns transient errors into sign-out
Studio Leaf ids are 'f-' + path. Keys like 'name' would repeat across sections, but only one section renders at a time, so this is OK
No error boundary at the app root: one render error blanks the whole admin. Add an ErrorBoundary around <AdminApp/> routes

Studio field test ids are 'f-<key>' (brand name = f-name). The Look tab id is studio-tabs-theme. Recheck the Users drawer, the Staff invite link and selects after the main agent reviews my fixes.
rca of the issue: Users crash: UserDrawer always builds its body JSX. With id=null, useApi(null) returns loading=false, error=null, data=null, so `d.plan?.plan_name` throws a TypeError and, with no error boundary, unmounts the whole tree. Selects: the Field component returned children instead of wrapping them in Tag. Invite link: the parent's loading early return unmounted the child that held the link state.
